pages.text: After you've got some $(bold)plant fiber$(), you are ready to get some stone tools and progress on your mining skills.

pages.title: Cobble types
pages.text: First, you'll need to mine some stone and get $(bold)cobble.$() The cobble type you get depends on the stone you mine, but for crafting tools all cobbles work.
Once you've got your cobble pieces, you need to combine them with plant fiber and sticks on a specific order to make your first stone tools.
